sources.title: Maps of the Auditory Cortex
used_for: 频率拓扑+周期拓扑双轴
sources.key_finding: 人类听觉皮层包含11个听觉场图，以苜蓿叶簇模式排列，与视觉皮层有平行架构

sources.title: The what, where and how of auditory-object perception
sources.key_finding: 声音对象感知依赖腹侧/背侧双流，皮层响应在层级越高处越与感知报告相关

sources.title: An expanded role for the dorsal auditory pathway in sensorimotor control and integration
used_for: 语音感知的感觉运动整合
sources.key_finding: 背侧听觉流通过efference copy整合听觉预期与发音运动，是语音感知的前向模型基础

sources.title: Distinct Cortical Pathways for Music and Speech Revealed by Hypothesis-Free Voxel Decomposition
sources.authors: Norman-Haignere S, Kanwisher NG, McDermott JH
used_for: 音乐/语音选择性双成分
非初级皮层的类别特化
sources.key_finding: 非初级皮层包含独立的音乐选择性（颞极/颞平面）和语音选择性（颞上回外侧）成分，不能被声学特征解释

sources.title: Phonetic feature encoding in human superior temporal gyrus
sources.authors: Mesgarani N, Cheung C, Johnson K, Chang EF
sources.key_finding: 人类STG通过STRF调谐实现音素特征选择性，声学到音素的转化在皮层通过非线性整合完成

sources.title: Large-scale single-neuron speech sound encoding across the depth of human cortex
sources.authors: Leonard MK, Makin JG, Bhattasali S, et al.
used_for: 深度依赖功能分层（浅层=音调，中深=音素）
sources.key_finding: STG 61%神经元语音响应，浅层编码相对音调，中深层（~3-4mm）编码音素特征且延迟最短

sources.title: Invariance to background noise as a signature of non-primary auditory cortex
used_for: 非初级皮层噪声不变性（t=8.37）
不依赖注意力的噪声鲁棒性
结构性vs高斯噪声的分离
sources.key_finding: 非初级听觉皮层对真实世界背景噪声的不变性显著高于初级皮层（p < 10⁻⁵），不依赖注意力

sources.title: The Neuronal Basis of Predictive Coding Along the Auditory Pathway: From the Subcortical Roots to Cortical Deviance Detection
used_for: 层级梯度（A1~25%, 带区~80%预测误差）
sources.key_finding: SSA和MMN是预测编码的microscopic/macroscopic层面；预测误差沿听觉通路升级，带区可达~80%

sources.title: Plasticity of temporal information processing in the primary auditory cortex
used_for: NB-ACh驱动听觉皮层时间可塑性
双向可调皮层跟随速率
sources.key_finding: NB刺激配对特定声音序列在20-25天内永久改变听觉皮层时间处理能力，效果双向可调

sources.title: Task-specific invariant representation in auditory cortex
sources.authors: Heller CR, Fritz JB, Shamma SA
used_for: 非初级皮层任务特异性表征
初级vs非初级的任务响应差异
sources.key_finding: 非初级听觉皮层在辨别任务中形成类别不变表征，初级皮层只有非特异性增强

sources.title: NIH NIDCD: Hearing, Ear Infections, and Deafness
sources.authors: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders
used_for: 临床意义（听力损失、耳鸣）
sources.key_finding: 官方机构来源，提供听觉系统和听力障碍的背景知识
